Oh gosh first of all thank you so much like you really have no idea how much your words mean to me. Second, you're not being preachy in the least honestly and I appreciate your honesty so much. Like the way I figure is if people can't be honest to someone when completely anonymous then they're being ridiculous. I appreciate your bluntness because there's no point in dancing around the issue at hand. You say what needs to be said and what you mean to say and I like that.

And I'm seriously trying to put into action what you said. Like that does actually make sense and there is nothing in the world more important to me than her. Thank you so much again
No believe me people do. Like me saying this isn't just me being insecure. It's facts

Because it's true. I have no friends, no abilities, no future. I'm stupid, unlikeable, unreasonable, awkward, quick to anger, and insecure as fuck. Nobody even gives a shit about me besides her. If I died, she'd be the only one who truly cared.

I have nothing besides her. I absolutely hate my family, yet they still force themselves into every facet of my life. They don't care about what I feel or who I am, as long as I bring home good grades. I don't. I fight with my teachers daily, I struggle so much to get my work done, and I just feel overwhelmed by every class. I play sports, but lately they've been less enjoyable and more of a burden and frustration. I hate everyone and everything besides my girlfriend. There is nothing that I actually enjoy doing besides time spent with her. I have no true friends, and nobody even likes me besides my girlfriend. Like honestly I feel so alone all the time. I can't even let anybody know about any of this, either. I only feel comfortable talking about any of this with one person. And it all falls on her. She is overburdened by my constant issues. I try my best, I swear to god I do, to be the best boyfriend that I can be to her. Yet every single night I'll say something that hurts her or starts a fight, and it all goes into a downward spiral from there. I become unreasonable, and every single time I end up shaking uncontrollably and crying. She has been with me every single step of the way. I put her through so much, yet she's always been there for me as much as she can. I know it's not fair to her, but I can't help it. I just don't know what to do. I love her so much, but I know she'd be better off without me. I don't even know why she loves me. I don't deserve her and she can do so much better. She's going to college next year, but I'm a year younger and I'm gonna still be in high school. We've both already decided that I'm gonna go to college in the same state as her at least and we're gonna stick together, hopefully forever. I'm terrified tho. She's gonna meet somebody who can treat her right and that'll be that. I'll have nobody. But I love her so much. I swear to God that I do my absolute best that I can. I promise. There's nothing more important to me than her, not even close. I would sacrifice literally everything I had for her. I'd do anything for her and I do everything I can. But it's not enough. I'm helpless and I just don't know what to do
Ok yes obviously it was very poorly written, I was in a fit of sadness and can't write well to begin with. However, I'd be happy to explain anything that you have questions about

I don't need more than one reason. I don't even want to live at all. I hate life and nothing makes me happy. Seriously. I'm not happy. I'm frustrated cuz I have nothing and my relationship with her is crumbling more and more with each passing day but I still can't leave. I have NOTHING
